turns.text: Now, part three of the test is very similar to part one of the test.
turns.zh: 那么，考试的第三部分和第一部分非常相似。

turns.text: Both of them are question and answer format.
That means the examiner will ask a question, the candidate will answer the question.
turns.zh: 也就是说，考官会问一个问题，考生来回答。

turns.text: However, look at these two questions.

turns.zh: 哪个问题是关于你自己的？
